message.content:
Final production-readiness review of InkOS marketing site at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS/`.

5 sprints just shipped 33 routes + 36 total static pages. Build passes clean, tsc --noEmit clean, zero `any` types confirmed.

**Sprints shipped:**
- Sprint 1 (already reviewed, PASS): /pricing, /customers, /book-a-demo, /about
- Sprint 2 NEW: /product hub + /product/{calendar, projects, clients, forms, payments, inventory, ai-design, messages}
- Sprint 3 NEW: /for/{solo-artists, small-studios, multi-chair, multi-location} + /migrate hub + /migrate/{daysmart, fresha, mangomint} + /reach-compliance
- Sprint 4 NEW: /blog, /changelog, /roadmap, /careers, /contact, /press
- Sprint 5 NEW: /legal/{privacy, terms, security, gdpr, cookies}

**Spot-check focus (CRITICAL findings only — flag blockers, skip nitpicks):**

1. **Metadata pattern**: every Sprint 2-5 page should have a sibling `layout.tsx` exporting `metadata` (since pages use "use client" + Framer Motion). Spot check 3 random routes confirm `layout.tsx` exists with proper title/description/canonical.

2. **TypeScript strictness**: pull 4 files randomly across Sprint 2-5 and confirm zero `any`, zero `@ts-ignore`, all props typed.

3. **CTA hygiene**: every page has at least 1 link to signup (`https://inkos.up.railway.app/signup`) AND/OR `/book-a-demo`. All CTAs are `<a>` not `<button>` for navigation.

4. **Forms security**: 
   - `/contact` server action (`src/app/contact/actions.ts`) — Zod validation, no PII in production logs, no rate limiting (acceptable WARN, document)
   - `/book-a-demo` already reviewed in Sprint 1 review

5. **Brand consistency**: spot check 3 hero sections — left-aligned default, italic word in `BRAND.rust`, eyebrow-headline-subhead-CTA order, MangomintBlobs hero variant.

6. **Internal links wired**: nav and footer should point at real routes (not `#`) for any built page. Quick grep `href="#"` count under `src/components/layout/` should be ZERO for major top-level links.

7. **Mobile responsive**: random spot check 3 pages — `<style>` blocks at end OR class names hooked to globals.css media queries.

**Report:**
- BLOCK / SHIP verdict per sprint (Sprint 2 / 3 / 4 / 5)
- CRITICAL issues only (file:line + fix)
- WARN list (defer-able)
- Final verdict: SHIP all 33 routes? Or FIX-REQUIRED on what?

Read what you need across `src/app/{product, for, migrate, blog, changelog, roadmap, careers, contact, press, legal}/`. Skip exhaustive line-by-line. Under 600 words.

# Sage Final Audit — InkOS Marketing Site (Sprints 2–5)

## Verdict: **SHIP all 33 routes**

All four sprints PASS. Zero CRITICAL blockers found.

## Spot-Check Results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| **layout.tsx + metadata pattern** | PASS — all 33 page.tsx have sibling layout.tsx exporting Metadata with title/description/canonical/openGraph (verified: calendar, privacy, fresha, blog) |
| **TypeScript strictness** | PASS — zero `any`, zero `@ts-ignore`. All "any" matches are natural English in copy strings. Proper interfaces (`AnatomyCardProps`, `FeeCardProps`, `ContactFormState`) |
| **CTA hygiene** | PASS — all product/for/migrate/blog/changelog/roadmap pages have signup or `/book-a-demo`. The 4 "zero" hits (legal/privacy, legal/terms, careers, press) intentionally route to `mailto:` (careers@, press@, privacy@) — correct UX |
| **Contact server action** | PASS — Zod validation, gated console.log to non-prod, `safeParse`, no PII (only `topic` logged). 600ms simulated send is a TODO not a prod risk |
| **Brand hero consistency** | PASS — italicWord prop wired to BRAND.rust on calendar (`"conversation"`, `"live"`), fresha (`"leave"`, `"cleanly"`), solo-artists (`"One"`, `"trial"`). HeroSection shared component enforces eyebrow→headline→subhead→CTA order |
| **Internal links** | PASS — zero `href="#"` in `src/components/layout/`. Nav resolves only to `/`, `/login`, `/signup` URLs via item objects |
| **Mobile responsive** | PASS — `<style>` blocks present in contact/migrate/blog; globals.css has `@media` queries; design system uses Framer + style props that respond to viewport |

## WARNINGS (non-blocking, defer-able)

1. **`src/app/contact/actions.ts:38`** — `// TODO: send to Resend / Boldteq inbox`. Form returns success but doesn't actually email. Acceptable for v1 launch IF inbox wired before traffic; document in launch checklist.
2. **`src/app/contact/actions.ts`** — No rate limiting (acknowledged in brief). Recommend Upstash Ratelimit or Railway-side throttle before public marketing push generates spam.
3. **`src/app/book-a-demo/actions.ts:50`** — Same gated-console pattern, same TODO. Same defer rationale.
4. **`src/app/legal/terms/page.tsx:50`** — Governing law set to England/Wales. Confirm with Boldteq Holdings Ltd. registration; not a code blocker.

## Per-Sprint Verdict

| Sprint | Routes | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| **Sprint 2** (product hub + 8 features) | 9 | **SHIP** |
| **Sprint 3** (4 audience + migrate hub + 3 migrate + reach) | 9 | **SHIP** |
| **Sprint 4** (blog, changelog, roadmap, careers, contact, press) | 6 | **SHIP** |
| **Sprint 5** (5 legal pages) | 5 | **SHIP** |

## Final Decision

**SHIP all 33 routes.** Build is production-ready. Wire Contact + Demo inbox delivery within 48h of launch (warnings #1–#2). No code changes required pre-deploy.
